title: Vermilion City Gym Leader
threat_analysis: Lt. Surge's Classic Hard Mode team is a high-voltage blitz designed around paralysis attrition and physical speed. His lead, Voltorb/Krabby (Lv. 27), combines Krabby's high base Attack (80) with Electric STAB Spark and Water coverage to threaten Ground switch-ins. Pikachu/Diglett (Lv. 27) possesses blazing 93 base Speed, Ground STAB Mud-Slap to lower accuracy, and total immunity to Electric attacks. His Ace, Raichu/Electabuzz (Lv. 29), is an apex sweeper (480 BST, 106 Speed, 91 SpA, 85 Atk) holding a Sitrus Berry: it opens with Thunder Wave to quarter your Speed, stacks Double Team evasion, and executes lethal Magnet-boosted Thunder Punches.
tactical_counter_plan: Ground Immunity is Paramount: Catch a Diglett or Dugtrio in Diglett's Cave (levels 15-22). Ground typing grants 100% immunity to Surge's primary Electric STAB (Spark, Thunder Shock, Thunder Wave, Thunder Punch), completely neutering Raichu/Electabuzz and shutting down Static triggers.

Bulbasaur Team Strategy: Ivysaur resists both Electric and Water, taking minimal damage from Voltorb/Krabby. Use Sleep Powder to shut down Raichu/Electabuzz before it stacks Double Team evasion, then plant Leech Seed. Fuse Dugtrio or Geodude with Ivysaur or support with a Ground/Grass wall.

Charmander Team Strategy: Charmeleon is vulnerable to Voltorb/Krabby's Water coverage. Splicing Charmeleon or a Mankey/Primeape with Diglett creates a high-speed Ground/Fighting or Ground/Fire offensive breaker that outspeeds Surge and hits back with super-effective Magnitude or Dig.

Squirtle Team Strategy: DO NOT send pure Wartortle into Electric STAB. Fuse Wartortle with a Ground type (Geodude or Diglett) to gain Electric immunity while preserving massive Shell Armor / Torrent bulk. Wartortle's Water STAB easily washes away Pikachu/Diglett.
Status Management: Equip your lead duelists with Cheri Berries (or Lum Berries) to absorb the initial Thunder Wave or Static paralysis proc without losing tempo.
rewards: Thunder Badge (Enables move Teleport to act as Fly fast-travel outside battle, boosts Pokémon Speed by 10%)
